fusions.name: Tethered Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a tethered blade that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then swings on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Shared Shackle
fusions.desc: Lashes the tethered blade at a target up to 4 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Barbed Dragline
fusions.desc: Stretches a barbed line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. Each one it catches is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
